why it occurred.

decisions.location: Independent raw primary benchmark/replication-purpose context; original identity evidence in strict_literal_parent_applied_0007.json
decisions.reason: The current independent school-district trial explicitly identifies TWO initial READS trials, Kim2006 and Kim/White2008, as the experiments it attempts to replicate. The only shipped counterpart is Kim/White2008. Current Introduction separately describes Kim2006 treatment/comparison and printed bibliography identifies its distinct single-author paper; independent original publisher/author-institution abstract confirms552students/10schools versus400children in the2008trial. Thus Kim2006is genuinely absent. The new literal passage establishes actual retesting/identity, not an outcome from control-group summer loss. Earlier failed outcome is withheld: overall full-sample failure and exploratory poverty-heterogeneity evidence must not be mistaken for an original-specific conclusion derived from the quoted control arm. Retain the validated native identity-only unknown outcome; no blanket success/failure is forced.
